---
title: "Logo path existing both relative to the document and to the project"
format: revealjs
logo: img/top.png
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      fileExists:
        outputPath: img/top.png
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<img src="img(/|\\)top\.png" class="slide-logo"'
        -
          - '<img src="\.\.(/|\\)img(/|\\)top\.png"'
---

`img/top.png` exists both next to this document and at the project root. Logo paths are relative to the document, so the document-relative file is used without a deprecation warning. Versions 1.8 to 1.10 picked the project-root file here, because they prefixed every logo path with `/` when the project had a brand.
